clause.text: Special provisions may be made for the advancement of women, children or disabled persons.

case_context.legal_issue: Whether any special provisions for advancement of disabled persons under Article 12(4) were relevant or applied in this case.
key_facts: Petitioner is disabled, having lost his lower left limb due to a land mine injury.

reasoning.interpretation_summary: The court noted the petitioner’s disability but did not materially engage Article 12(4) in its reasoning or decision.
reasoning.application_to_facts: The petitioner’s disability was acknowledged but no special provisions under Article 12(4) were applied or discussed.

link_explanation.why_this_clause_matters: Article 12(4) was not materially engaged or relied upon in the court’s reasoning or holding.

evidence.evidence_excerpt: The petitioner is 26 years of age and married with 2 children. According to him, in 1991 he had accidentally stepped on a land mine, which cost him his lower left limb.
